content: रिच् I. €7 <ab>U.</ab> (रिणाक्ति, रिङ्क्ते, रिक्त) .²1 To empty, evacuate, clear, purge; रिणच्मि जलधेस्तोयम् <ls>Bk. 6. 36</ls>; आविर्भूते शशिनि तमसा रिच्यमानेव रात्रिः <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>; तिमिररिच्यमानं पूर्वदिङ्मुखमालोकसुभगं दृश्यते <ls>V. 3</ls>. .²2 To deprive of, make destitute of. .²3 To separate, divide. .²4 To give or deliver up, part with. .²5 To bequeath (usually in {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%}, see रिक्त). --II. €1. €10 <ab>P.</ab> (रेचति, रेचयति, रेचित) .²1 To divide, separate, disjoin. .²2 To abandon, leave. .²3 To join, mix. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To evacuate, make empty. .²2 To discharge, emit (as breath). .²3 To leave, abandon.
